Zoe: FYI - auth failures surfaced for several Private (VPC) tenants starting ~02:10 UTC. Customers report inference 401s and timeouts. Need a short external note + high-touch plan for affected renewal-risk accounts.
Arun: Investigating. Early traces show token validation errors from the private auth proxy after a cert rotation job. Looks like a race where new certs cached/out-of-sync.
Kim: Can we hot-reload proxy certs without restart? If not, we should roll back the rotation and re-run a targeted reload.
Arun: Hot-reload possible for most clusters; rolling now for impacted VPC regions. ETA ~18m to validate.
Zoe: Drafting customer message - short, avoid implying data exposure, offer immediate rollback and manual re-sync if needed. Also propose 15% credit for any requests that returned errors. Thoughts?
Layla (Privacy): Keep language cautious. Use "may have experienced authentication failures"; do not promise credits publicly — instead say "we will evaluate account-level credits and remediation". Also confirm we have no indication of data access.
Ben: I'll prep the high-touch email templates for the top 6 renewal-risk tenants and schedule 1:1 calls after we confirm restoration.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-900 created, severity P2, bridge scheduled.
Kim: Hot-reload completed for 4 clusters at 02:35 UTC; auth success rates returning to baseline in those regions. Still validating two downstream proxies.
Arun: Full validation done at 02:48 UTC. All impacted VPC tenants showing normal auth behavior. Collecting traces for RCA.
Zoe: Draft snippet for public CS note: ```Hi — we detected an authentication issue this morning that may have caused inference requests to fail for some private VPC tenants. Our engineering team rolled back a certificate rotation and performed targeted cert reloads to restore service. If you continue to see 401s or timeouts please contact your CS rep and we will prioritize an immediate re-sync for your tenant. We are evaluating account-level remediation and will follow up with an RCA. — Redwood Inference```
Layla (Privacy): Good. Replace "rolled back a certificate rotation" with "rolled back a recent certificate update". Add "we have no indication of data exposure".
Zoe: Updated and uploaded final note to comms. Ben, please queue high-touch outreach for the renewal-risk list and include a short diagnostic checklist for customers to run before the call.
Ben: Will do. Scheduling calls and prepping diagnostics.
Zoe: Sending public note now. After RCA, we'll update account health scores and propose credits for customers who reported errors. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
